title: Use Result/Either type instead of throwing raw exceptions in domain services
description: Domain services must return Result<T, E> rather than throwing raw Error instances to force explicit error handling by callers.
guidelines: Do not throw Error in service methods
Handle errors explicitly at controller or route boundaries

evidence.author: tech-lead
evidence.commentBody: Please do not throw raw Error here; return Result.fail so caller is forced to handle it.

evidence.author: senior-arch
evidence.commentBody: Convention reminder: all methods in *.service.ts must return Result<T, DomainError> instead of throwing.

title: Always add index on foreign key columns in database migrations
description: Every foreign key column must have an explicit index defined to avoid full table scans during joins and delete cascades.
guidelines: Define an index on every foreign key column

evidence.author: dba-lead
evidence.commentBody: Missing index on organization_id. FK columns must always have an explicit index in migrations.

title: Use structured logger instead of console.log/console.error in application code
description: Direct console calls bypass structured JSON logging, trace context, and log level filtering in production.
guidelines: Inject logger service or import app logger
Include context metadata in log statements

evidence.author: devops-eng
evidence.commentBody: Please replace console.log with our structured logger instance.
